latest.title: Minimal Player, Track Sharing and Smooth Scrolling
changes: Refined the mini player with quieter controls, less backdrop blur, and a compact three-dot track menu.
Added Song Info, highest-quality AAC download and Share Song Link actions for the currently playing track.
Added compact Mujic share URLs using ?s=<song-id>; opening the URL resolves the exact catalogue song through the Render-backed API and starts that track.
Moved desktop wheel-to-horizontal scrolling handlers from the document to individual rails, reducing interference with normal vertical page scrolling.
Changed the main vertical scroller to native scrolling and reduced mini-player paint and transition costs.
Moved track info/share/deep-link logic into a dedicated js/track-actions.js feature chunk while preserving the existing feature-module loading order.

entries.title: Minimal Player, Track Sharing and Smooth Scrolling
changes: Refined the mini player with quieter controls, less backdrop blur, and a compact three-dot track menu.
Added Song Info, highest-quality AAC download and Share Song Link actions for the currently playing track.
Added compact Mujic share URLs using ?s=<song-id>; opening the URL resolves the exact catalogue song through the Render-backed API and starts that track.
Moved desktop wheel-to-horizontal scrolling handlers from the document to individual rails, reducing interference with normal vertical page scrolling.
Changed the main vertical scroller to native scrolling and reduced mini-player paint and transition costs.
Moved track info/share/deep-link logic into a dedicated js/track-actions.js feature chunk while preserving the existing feature-module loading order.

entries.title: Online Watermark, Scrolling, Resume and Lyrics Fixes
changes: Forced the large Mujic footer wordmark to remain high-contrast and visible at the end of Online Home.
Added previous/next controls and robust desktop horizontal scrolling to the Home Artists and Similar Artists rails.
Kept add-to-custom-playlist and highest-quality AAC download actions available for Online song cards and rows.
Highlighted the currently playing Online queue entry with an accent stripe, title treatment and animated playing indicator.
Persisted current song, queue and precise playback position per workspace, including while Resume Playback is disabled; switching back restores the saved position when Play is pressed.
Retried the backend-relayed Lyrics.ovh fallback for previously unavailable lyrics while online, for both local-library and streaming tracks.
Bumped media-cache namespaces and automatically deleted superseded media chunk/image caches on service-worker activation.

entries.title: Online Home Simplification and Playback Efficiency
changes: Reduced Online Home to one artist scroller; full artist directory remains accessible.
Added a Liked Songs tile beside custom Online playlists, with direct navigation to Online liked songs.
Matched the Online mobile navigation active highlight to the Offline navigation treatment.
Kept artwork lazy-loaded and changed remote audio to metadata-first native streaming; existing next-track stream prefetch remains enabled for upcoming queue items.
Bumped service-worker cache namespace. Offline UI and local playback logic remain unchanged.

entries.title: Online Performance, Artist Lazy Loading and Home Polish
changes: Artist detail requests no duplicate profile-song preview batch and load one bounded song page initially; additional pages load only on demand.
Select only the highest-quality artwork URL for display and one highest-quality source for playback, while retaining independent AAC/M4A filtering for downloads.
Removed hidden artwork preloads that duplicated visible image requests and kept track metadata caching bounded.
Added the ListenFree-style artist mosaic to Online Home, interactive artist-wall controls, Quick Picks, English Hits and a muted Mujic wordmark at the bottom of Home.
Fixed Online liked-song hydration for older namespaced saved IDs and kept artist/profile cache bounded.
Changed only Online workspace styling and Online-specific logic; the Offline interface and local-library behavior remain unchanged.

entries.title: Render-Only API and Media Routing
changes: Kept every documented catalogue API request on the Render backend /api route and routed LRCLIB/LyricsPlus calls through fixed Render endpoints.
Added a same-backend media relay for known Saavn/JioSaavn audio and artwork CDNs, including byte-range forwarding so playback seeking remains supported.
Restricted media proxy requests and redirects to HTTPS hosts under saavncdn.com and jiosaavn.com instead of creating an arbitrary URL proxy.
Included a merge-safe Flask patch and deployment instructions; the live Render service must be updated and redeployed separately.
Kept app UI and Offline workspace unchanged and bumped the PWA cache namespace.

entries.title: Render-Only API Routing
changes: Routed all catalogue API requests through the configured Render backend under /api, preserving the documented search, song, suggestion, artist, album and playlist paths.
Added fixed-origin, allowlisted server-side proxy routes for the catalogue API; arbitrary destination URLs are not accepted.
Routed LRCLIB exact/search and LyricsPlus fallback requests through the same Render backend instead of calling those API hosts from the browser.
Included a merge-safe backend route patch and deployment instructions; these server routes must be merged into the live Render backend and redeployed to activate proxy endpoints.
Kept the app UI and Offline workspace unchanged and bumped the PWA cache namespace.

entries.title: Foreign Artist Song Retrieval Fix
changes: Added an artist-name-based song-search fallback when the documented artist-song endpoint returns an empty collection for an international artist.
Filter fallback songs by exact artist ID or normalized artist name, preventing unrelated search results from leaking into artist pages.
Keep empty artist song pages retryable rather than rendering a zero-result API response as a completed catalogue.
Improve song artist display by checking artistMap primary-artist metadata when normal artist arrays are absent.

entries.title: Seamless Home, Artist Discovery and Search Queue Fixes
changes: Kept Online Home title, mode switch and action buttons on the same responsive geometry as Offline Home without changing the Offline view.
Added Most Played Artists Home shelf beside suggested and recently played artists, backed by local play-count and recency statistics.
Rejected explicitly non-artist API entities from artist discovery and refreshed artist/catalogue cache namespaces.
Ensured tapping a search result starts only that song and automatic Up Next prioritizes the documented similar-song endpoint.
Improved multi-word search relevance to prevent unrelated partial word matches from being queued.
Kept sharing and streaming-cache controls together in Library & Listening settings, and bumped the PWA cache version.

entries.title: Artist Explorer and Search Queue Fixes
changes: Aligned Online Home header geometry with Offline Home.
Added an API-backed Artists explorer with personalized artist shelves and play-count sorting.
Fixed search taps to play the selected song and improved related-track-only autoplay suggestions.
Moved library sharing and streaming cache controls into Library & Listening settings.

entries.title: Artist profiles, suggestions and playlist deduplication
changes: Rebuilt Home artist discovery around exact artist names, clickable portrait cards and artist-specific image fallback from the documented artist and song-artist records.
Improved artist detail retries and pagination so a failed first page or a short preview does not silently mark a catalogue complete.
Removed equivalent recordings from imported and saved online playlists, liked songs, history, playback lists and automatic suggestions, including duplicates with different catalogue IDs.
Added initials-based portrait fallbacks instead of generic artist icons, and removed the misleading Unknown Artist subtitle from artist entities.
Tightened the offline Home top spacing, positioned its mode toggle beside Home, and repaired Library-sharing and streaming-cache settings descriptions without redesigning the Offline workspace.
Versioned the PWA cache and expanded regression coverage for artist portrait recovery, catalogue links and queue-safe suggestion deduplication.

entries.title: Artist catalogue and workspace polish
changes: Added a swipeable Artist shelf to Home; artist cards open a detail page and preserve the correct root navigation selection.
Fixed artist song pagination so page-size inference uses returned rows, retries failed pages, and avoids caching incomplete catalogues as complete.
Fixed artwork fallback parsing, duplicate-track filtering, direct song IDs/share links, and playback messages.
Reduced extra Home spacing, placed the mode switch beside Home, added a mode transition animation and a large muted Mujic footer wordmark.
Retained the four-tab navigation, separate local/streaming liked songs and playlists, and refined the Library sharing and cache settings.

entries.title: Minimal streaming UX and full artist catalogue
changes: Merged the online listening history and upcoming queue into tabs in the Online Library; kept the Offline navigation unchanged.
Removed repeated per-track mode badges, tightened the Online top edge, and kept a compact mode switch beside the Home actions.
Added a swipeable, clickable circular artist rail and complete paginated artist songs/albums detail loading.
Fixed short-page pagination metadata and search shelf collection so catalogue APIs capped at a few results per page can still continue.
Artist Play waits for the full fetched track catalogue and removes equivalent duplicate recordings before building playback context.
Kept Online Favorites/playlists/history/queue separate from Offline; appearance settings remain shared through the app settings model.
Added ID/link support for song lookup and detail helpers for albums, artists and playlists; updated regression checks and app-shell version.

entries.title: Clean streaming workspace
changes: Redesigned the streaming workspace with clean horizontal music and public-playlist shelves, collection details, and a compact mode switch beside the add action.
Kept streaming-specific layout and behavior in its own stylesheet and dedicated JavaScript modules; the Offline stylesheet was not changed in this release.
Improved short-page search handling so initial search fills up to 24 unique results and further results remain available through Load More.
Strengthened duplicate and remix detection in autoplay recommendations while preserving alternate tracks that users explicitly select in search.
Added public playlist discovery plus album, artist, and playlist detail loading using the documented catalogue endpoints.
Lyrics lookup inspects embedded response text and song details before using external fallback sources; no undocumented lyrics endpoint is assumed.
Updated the service-worker shell cache for the isolated streaming stylesheet and refreshed version metadata.

entries.title: Separate Online and Offline workspaces
changes: Switched the primary online catalogue adapter to the supplied supplied catalogue API contract: song search uses query/page/limit, song details, and documented suggestions endpoints; Machhar remains a compatibility fallback.
Separated Online search, online search history, listening history, playlists and queue snapshots from the Offline library, history, playlists and queues.
Manual search/playlist playback keeps all visible results and variants. Strong duplicate/remix/version filtering applies to automatic recommendations so a user-selected remix remains playable.
Short API pages now trigger a bounded automatic page probe and Load More remains available; online metadata cache can retain up to 50 recent result records and warms a small number of artworks.
Improved queue switching/resume source safety and recommendation queue filling so online playback can continue beyond the initial search results.
Added optional Linked workspaces for copying offline playlists to matched online catalogue tracks and online playlists to tracks already present in the local library.
Added a clear red Online mode marker with yellow beta/disconnected status, dedicated connectivity/error recovery, and separate workspace navigation.
Updated lyrics lookup to respect the supplied spec: catalog/details first where lyric text is available, then LRCLIB and optional LyricsPlus; the spec does not define a dedicated lyrics endpoint.
Updated service-worker cache and project documentation for the new dual-workspace build.
Fixed a pagination calculation bug: short pages now compare the provider’s actual start offset plus returned count against the documented total, not the requested page size.
Natural autoplay skips an exact track or likely remix/alternate recording already heard in recent Online history; manual selection of those search results remains allowed.
Added the Online Queue directly to workspace navigation and restored the missing installable-PWA icon assets.

entries.title: Optional Online Playback (Beta)
changes: Added an accessible Offline / Online source switch; Offline remains the default on fresh installations.
Integrated the supplied Machhar backend for online search and stream resolution without replacing Mujic’s audio engine or main UI.
Added first-use beta consent, a persistent online-mode warning, request timeouts, and clearer failure states.
Remote stream URLs and catalogue results remain session-only and are not saved as local audio or local-library tracks.

entries.title: Stability and cleanup
changes: Fixed settings import silently dropping the Midnight Blue and Warm Espresso palettes; repeat and seek-step values are now range-checked on import.
Reordering the queue while shuffled no longer overwrites the original order or drops duplicate songs.
Removing a song now also deletes its cached lyrics and its cover art when no other song uses it.
Storage helpers no longer hang on IndexedDB errors; Clear All waits for the transaction to finish.
New setting to turn off the community lyrics server (sends title and artist to a third-party host).
Removed dead code, corrected misleading comments, memoised placeholder artwork, and made ignored errors visible in the debug console.
Added automated checks that keep saved, loaded, imported and on-screen settings consistent.

entries.title: Professional polish pass
changes: Settings now lead with the common choices; rarely used options sit under collapsible 'More appearance options', 'Advanced playback' and 'Advanced lyrics layout'. Every setting is still available.
Quieter settings rows (descriptions only where they prevent mistakes), a dedicated red Clear Library row, and the unfinished 'Coming soon' row removed from view.
Friendlier empty state with a clear privacy line, consistent toasts, visible keyboard focus, higher-contrast secondary text, and a Back label on detail pages.
Desktop: highlighted sidebar item, full-width bottom player bar and thin scrollbars.
Consistent spring motion, tighter corner/weight scale, fixed-size icon boxes, and off-screen song rows skipped for faster long lists.
Interface-only release: no JavaScript changed. Service-worker cache versioned for updates.

entries.title: Cleaner, Apple Music-inspired interface
changes: Flat song rows with inset hairline separators, bolder large titles and calmer section headings.
Solid settings, search and category surfaces; labelled bottom navigation; softer mini-player material.
Full player: vivid artwork backdrop, bare transport glyphs, and a scrubber that shows its handle only while touched.
Apple-style lyrics are left-aligned with soft edge fades.
Centered playlist/album covers with a Play and Shuffle button pair.
Interface-only release: playback, library, storage, lyrics and audio processing are unchanged. Service-worker cache versioned for updates.

entries.title: Desktop playlist navigation and player visual polish
changes: Desktop users can scroll Home playlist and Top Picks rails with the mouse wheel, with normal page scrolling preserved at rail edges.
Hardened playlist detail opening and artwork refresh so a previous playlist cover cannot carry over into another playlist.
Added a block-style drop shadow to the active Neon lyric line for more depth.
Changed the Default seek-bar waveform from a flat line to a compact, audio-responsive bar waveform and updated its settings preview.
Improved player-control tooltips and the Lyrics icon without changing playback, seeking, equalizer or audio processing behavior.
Versioned the service-worker cache so previously installed PWAs fetch the updated assets.

entries.title: About, Search and playlist picker polish
changes: Added a proper GitHub brand icon and responsive About links that remain readable on narrow screens.
Search empty-state action now opens the music downloader in a new tab and passes the entered query as an encoded q parameter.
Playlist Add Songs now selects multiple tracks already imported into the Mujic library instead of opening the device file picker.
Made the selected Audio Waveform style easier to identify in its settings sheet and displayed the current style as a consistent value pill.

entries.title: Restored navigation, Settings and core tap actions
changes: Fixed the root interaction regression: the delegated action handler was missing the dispatch cases for playback rows, Settings categories, library tabs, history, playlist actions and transport controls.

Restored actions for playing tracks, opening artists/albums/playlists, toggling lyrics, shuffle/repeat/favorite, opening Settings subpages, importing playlist songs, and renaming/deleting/reordering playlists.
Search playback now falls back to the full library queue when only one track matches, so Next does not get stuck at a one-track queue.
Added action-level error reporting and guarded optional pointer controls so missing UI elements cannot interrupt unrelated interactions.

entries.title: Startup and local-file navigation recovery
changes: Guarded browser-history URL writes on file:// launches so a SecurityError cannot stop navigation handlers from initializing.
Made UI subsystems initialize independently; a settings, history, gesture or optional-panel failure no longer prevents main navigation from binding.
Moved UI initialization inside the application bootstrap error boundary so unexpected startup failures are caught and reported instead of leaving a silent frozen screen.

entries.title: Home rail scrolling and launch reliability
changes: Prevented the changelog loader from fetching changlog.json from file://, avoiding a guaranteed browser CORS error and using bundled release notes in local-file mode.
Made Home playlist and Top Picks rails horizontally scrollable on touch devices by allowing horizontal gestures and preventing cards from shrinking to fit.
Renamed the player shortcut to Equalizer and shortened the Bass preset label while preserving the underlying equalizer settings and audio processing.

entries.title: Unified Audio Waveform settings and release consistency
changes: Merged waveform activation and waveform style into one settings row that opens the actual waveform-style sheet.
Fixed version metadata so update checks compare the installed build with the published VERSION instead of prompting for the current release.
Bumped the service-worker cache for this patch so previously installed PWAs can receive the corrected interface.
Updated the About copy to credit Ashutosh Roy (Machhar); Gemini song identification remains Coming soon with no active key manager or API calls.

entries.title: Unified Audio Waveform and playback reliability
changes: Combined Audio Waveform activation and seek-bar styling under one persistent setting, with the selected effect continuing on both full and mini player while enabled.
Made mobile menus opaque and removed active Gemini key/API functionality; AI Song Identification remains marked Coming soon.
Kept Favorite Artists inside Your Playlists, and retained update prompts, JSON settings/listening-data import, Search download fallback and GitHub About links.

entries.title: Gemini Auth API compatibility
changes: Switched Gemini key testing and AI song identification to Google’s Interactions REST API, the documented flow for current Gemini Auth API keys.
Corrected current Flash model fallback order and improved response parsing for Interactions API steps.
Added explicit diagnostics for legacy Standard keys, invalid keys, project permissions, quotas, model availability, and network errors.
Updated Gemini key setup help with the current Auth-key migration requirement.

entries.title: Gemini API compatibility and key validation
changes: Switched from the moving gemini-flash-latest alias to the documented gemini-3.8-flash stable model first, with gemini-3.6-flash and gemini-3.5-flash-lite fallback if Google reports a model endpoint unavailable.
Unified AI song matching and Test keys on one Gemini generateContent request helper using the documented x-goog-api-key header and JSON/text response handling.
Removed no-referrer request policy so API keys restricted to the local site or web origin can be validated properly.
Raised short request timeouts and added actionable messages for local-file launches, CORS/network failures, invalid/restricted keys, model access, and quota errors.
Save keys now verifies the IndexedDB write by reading the saved key list back; Test keys persists the current inputs before testing.

entries.title: Navigation and settings polish
changes: Added a compact Gemini API key help guide with setup steps and common error troubleshooting.
Added Favorite Artists beside Playlists on wide Home layouts and retained a compact stacked layout on phones.
Added horizontal swipes between Home, Library, Search and Settings without hijacking vertical scrolls, tracks, rails, controls or settings subpages.
Simplified the footer to “Made with ♥ by Machhar”.
Hid the waveform canvas and effect-only styling when Audio Waveform is Off; regular playback progress remains visible without glow.

entries.title: Local Gemini keys and performance profile
changes: Added Settings key manager for up to four local Gemini API keys with hide/show, save, test and fallback rotation.
Removed the same-origin Gemini API proxy; AI song identification now calls Google Gemini directly from the browser.
Added automatic Low-End Performance Profile and reduced artwork warm-up bursts, duplicate Web Audio setup and waveform canvas work.

entries.title: Production polish and performance mode
changes: Added Low-End Device Mode to reduce costly blur, shadows and nonessential motion, with a lower waveform frame rate.
Moved Lyrics Style into the dedicated Lyrics Display section and retained saved lyrics display preferences.
Added a built-in changelog fallback so release notes remain visible offline or when the changelog file cannot be fetched.
Replaced developer-facing setup messages with user-focused copy and updated the service-worker cache version.

entries.title: Waveform and lyrics layout refinement
changes: Capped the seek-bar canvas to a compact height and reduced waveform amplitude, frequency and secondary oscillation.
The active waveform replaces the played-section baseline; the unplayed timeline remains visible as a separate thin line.
Waveform stays static while paused and clears when the player or effect is closed.
Added saved lyrics position, fine offset, text size, line spacing, width and active-line emphasis controls.
Reworked mobile lyrics mode to reserve space for playback controls and keep text scrollable and centered without clipping.
Added a Change & Update Log page that fetches release notes from changlog.json.
Versioned the service-worker cache so the updated interface and release notes can replace older cached assets.

entries.title: Theme and settings refinements
changes: Added grouped settings, personal appearance preferences and solid surface styling.
Added a server-side experimental Gemini song identification endpoint while keeping the key out of client JavaScript.
